input.complaint: Compressor PA-204 mein बेयरिंग जाम हो गया है, awaaz bahut tez aa rahi hai, vibration bhi high hai, line 3 band hai

gold_output.symptom: Compressor bearing seized with high vibration and abnormal noise
gold_output.root_cause: Bearing failure due to lubrication starvation or contamination
gold_output.corrective_action: Stop machine, lockout-tagout, replace bearing assembly, flush lubrication circuit, verify alignment before restart

metadata.notes: Air compressor bearing failure — classic line stoppage scenario

input.complaint: Motor M-117 बहुत गरम हो रहा है, smell jal rahi hai, current draw normal se zyada hai abhi

gold_output.symptom: Electric motor overheating with burning smell and elevated current draw
gold_output.root_cause: Winding insulation degradation likely from sustained overload or cooling fan failure
gold_output.corrective_action: De-energize circuit, megger-test windings, inspect cooling fan and ducts, replace motor if insulation resistance below 1 megohm

metadata.notes: Motor overheating, fire risk — critical severity

input.complaint: Hydraulic press HP-08 का pressure drop ho raha hai, oil leak ho raha hai cylinder ke neeche se

gold_output.symptom: Hydraulic pressure drop with visible oil leak at cylinder base
gold_output.root_cause: Cylinder rod seal failure or worn piston seal allowing internal bypass
gold_output.corrective_action: Isolate hydraulic supply, drain cylinder, replace rod and piston seal kit, flush reservoir, refill with ISO VG 46 oil

metadata.notes: Hydraulic leak — workplace hazard, cleanup required

input.complaint: Conveyor CV-12 belt slip ho raha hai, drive pulley pe ghissa hai, material gir raha hai

gold_output.symptom: Conveyor belt slipping at drive pulley with material spillage
gold_output.root_cause: Insufficient belt tension or worn drive pulley lagging
gold_output.corrective_action: Adjust take-up tensioner per OEM spec, inspect pulley lagging and replace if worn beyond 3mm, verify belt tracking

metadata.notes: Conveyor belt slip — common in cement, food processing plants

input.complaint: CNC machine CNC-03 का spindle vibration bahut zyada hai, finish kharab aa raha hai, tool life kam hai

gold_output.symptom: CNC spindle excessive vibration causing poor surface finish and reduced tool life
gold_output.root_cause: Spindle bearing wear or unbalanced tool holder
gold_output.corrective_action: Run vibration spectrum analysis, check tool holder balance with G2.5 standard, replace spindle bearings if 1X RPM peak exceeds 4mm/s

input.complaint: Boiler B-02 का pressure kam ho raha hai, safety valve trip ho raha hai bar bar, feed water pump issue lag raha hai

gold_output.symptom: Boiler pressure decay with intermittent safety valve trips, suspected feed water pump issue
gold_output.root_cause: Feed water pump cavitation or check valve failure causing inadequate makeup flow
gold_output.corrective_action: Stop boiler per safe shutdown procedure, inspect feed pump suction strainer, test check valve, verify NPSH available exceeds required

input.complaint: Transformer TR-05 का oil temperature high ho raha hai, OLTC operation laga hua hai

gold_output.symptom: Distribution transformer elevated oil temperature with frequent OLTC operations
gold_output.root_cause: Overload or cooling system inadequacy, possibly degraded oil dielectric
gold_output.corrective_action: Sample oil for BDV and DGA, check radiator fans, reduce load if temperature exceeds 85C, schedule oil filtration

metadata.notes: Transformer thermal event — load shedding may be required

input.complaint: Punch press PP-09 stroke complete nahi kar raha, ram bich mein ruk raha hai, clutch issue ho sakta hai

gold_output.symptom: Punch press ram failing to complete stroke, stopping mid-cycle
gold_output.root_cause: Clutch-brake unit air pressure low or worn friction lining
gold_output.corrective_action: Lockout press, verify air supply at 6 bar minimum, inspect clutch lining thickness, replace if below 2mm, recalibrate brake monitor

metadata.notes: Press safety — operator injury risk if clutch fails

input.complaint: Cooling tower CT-1 fan vibrate kar raha hai, gearbox se awaaz aa rahi hai, oil level kam dikh raha hai

gold_output.symptom: Cooling tower fan vibration with abnormal gearbox noise and low oil level
gold_output.root_cause: Gearbox oil leak from output shaft seal causing internal wear
gold_output.corrective_action: Lockout fan, drain remaining gearbox oil, inspect gear teeth and bearings via inspection port, replace shaft seal and refill with ISO VG 320 gear oil

metadata.notes: Cooling tower — common at chemical and power plants

input.complaint: DG set DG-2 start hi nahi ho raha, battery weak hai shayad, fuel level theek hai

gold_output.symptom: Diesel generator failing to crank, suspected battery issue, fuel level normal
gold_output.root_cause: Discharged or sulfated starting battery, possibly failed battery charger
gold_output.corrective_action: Measure battery open-circuit voltage and specific gravity, test charger output, load-test battery, replace if capacity below 80 percent rated

metadata.notes: Standby DG failure to start — backup power compromised

input.complaint: Chiller CH-04 ka discharge pressure high hai, condenser tubes me scaling ho gaya hai shayad

gold_output.symptom: Chiller high discharge pressure, suspected condenser tube scaling
gold_output.root_cause: Condenser fouling from poor water treatment or non-condensables in refrigerant circuit
gold_output.corrective_action: Check approach temperature, perform chemical descaling of condenser tubes, verify water treatment dosing, evacuate and recharge if non-condensables suspected

input.complaint: Pump P-22 dry running ho rahi hai, no flow detected, suction line me leak ho sakta hai

gold_output.symptom: Centrifugal pump dry running with zero flow indication, suspected suction air ingress
gold_output.root_cause: Air ingress at suction joint or suction strainer choked causing loss of prime
gold_output.corrective_action: Stop pump immediately to prevent seal damage, isolate suction valve, inspect gasket and bolting, clean strainer, re-prime before restart

input.complaint: VFD-07 trip ho raha hai overcurrent fault dikha raha hai, motor cable insulation check karna hai

gold_output.symptom: VFD repeated overcurrent trip on driven motor
gold_output.root_cause: Motor cable insulation breakdown or motor winding fault causing earth leakage
gold_output.corrective_action: Disconnect motor, megger-test cable and motor at 1000V, check IR above 1 megohm, replace defective cable or rewind motor as needed

input.complaint: Welding robot WR-01 calibration off hai, weld bead position 2mm shift ho gaya hai

gold_output.symptom: Welding robot positional accuracy degraded with 2mm bead offset from program path
gold_output.root_cause: TCP calibration drift, possibly from collision or encoder backlash in joint axis
gold_output.corrective_action: Run robot home reference cycle, perform TCP 4-point calibration, check joint encoders for backlash, recover saved program offsets

input.complaint: Furnace FN-3 temperature uniformity kharab hai, zone 2 mein 30 degree kam hai compared to zone 1

gold_output.symptom: Furnace zone 2 temperature 30C below zone 1 setpoint indicating heating element or thermocouple issue
gold_output.root_cause: Burnt-out heating element bank or shifted thermocouple in zone 2
gold_output.corrective_action: Power down furnace, check element resistance balance across phases, verify thermocouple junction position and reference junction, replace defective element segments

input.complaint: Air dryer AD-2 ka pressure dew point bigad gaya hai, humid air aa raha hai instrument line me

gold_output.symptom: Compressed air dryer pressure dew point elevated, moisture carryover to instrument air system
gold_output.root_cause: Desiccant bed saturation from failed regeneration cycle or moist inlet air bypass
gold_output.corrective_action: Verify regeneration heater operation and purge valve timing, sample desiccant for friability, replace desiccant bed if degraded

metadata.notes: Instrument air quality — affects pneumatic controls

input.complaint: Centrifuge CF-1 unbalance trip kar raha hai, basket rotor par buildup ho gaya hoga

gold_output.symptom: Centrifuge unbalance trip during spin cycle, suspected uneven product buildup in basket
gold_output.root_cause: Asymmetric cake formation or scraper malfunction leaving residual deposit on basket wall
gold_output.corrective_action: Allow rotor to fully stop, manually inspect basket for deposit asymmetry, clean per SOP, verify scraper actuation, run dry balance check before next charge

input.complaint: Reactor agitator AG-5 का seal leak ho raha hai, nitrogen purge low ho gaya hai

gold_output.symptom: Reactor agitator mechanical seal leakage with corresponding loss of nitrogen barrier pressure
gold_output.root_cause: Mechanical seal faces worn or contaminated, allowing process side leakage
gold_output.corrective_action: Isolate reactor per SOP, depressurize and inert, replace mechanical seal cartridge, recommission with leak test prior to charging next batch

input.complaint: PLC PLC-15 me communication error aa raha hai HMI ke saath, intermittent disconnects ho rahe hain

gold_output.symptom: Intermittent PLC-HMI communication loss on Ethernet/IP segment
gold_output.root_cause: Network cable termination fault, switch port issue, or EMI from nearby variable-speed drive
gold_output.corrective_action: Inspect RJ45 connectors and shielding, swap switch port, segregate communication cable from power runs, log packet errors on managed switch for 24h

input.complaint: Bag filter BF-3 mein DP rise ho gaya hai, pulse cleaning system kharab hai shayad

gold_output.symptom: Baghouse filter differential pressure elevated above normal, suspected pulse jet cleaning system failure
gold_output.root_cause: Solenoid valve failure on pulse manifold or compressed air supply pressure insufficient
gold_output.corrective_action: Verify air receiver pressure at 6 bar, test each pulse valve sequence via PLC diagnostics, replace failed solenoids, inspect bags for blinding after restoring cleaning

input.complaint: Reactor agitator AG-5 seal leak with nitrogen pressure drop
